g.text: No secrets in images or Git
All workloads and deployment connections are proposed design, not live infrastructure.
Payment mock is inside the API workload; no external payment provider is deployed.
Production DB has no public client route. Local published DB ports, if any, bind loopback.
CI uses test data; migrations and backups require a reviewed release procedure.
Container-to-code mapping remains planned until apps/web and apps/api exist.
